tess (Docs): heads-up  i'm drafting a tiny "micro-guidance" note for the Optimize Toolkit that clarifies when to prefer batching vs. kv-prefetch for short-sequence traffic. found one fuzzy sentence and a moved example.
harry (Infra): good call. please show concrete settings (numbers) and one-line tradeoffs: latency vs mem.
tess (Docs): draft python snippet (very short):
# batch many short prompts and hint prefetch
requests = [{"prompt": p, "max_tokens": 24} for p in prompts]
client.batch_generate(requests, prefetch_window=32, enable_kv_prefetch=True)

mina (ML): add a quant compatibility note: for workloads that need prefix caching, prefer 8-bit or fp16-capable profiles. test any 4-bit profile with the eval harness; some 4-bit configs disable fp16-like kv caching.
jo (DevEx): please add a go example too and a one-line debug tip showing how to tell if prefetch was applied.
tess (Docs): go snippet idea:
reqs := make([]GenerateRequest, len(prompts))
for i,p := range prompts { reqs[i] = GenerateRequest{Prompt: p, MaxTokens:24} }
client.BatchGenerate(ctx, reqs, WithKVPrefetch(32)) // prefetch_window=32

jo (DevEx): debug hint: enable ClientConfig{Debug:true} and look for the log line "prefetch_applied=true" or "prefetch_skipped=short_prefix". include that verbatim so users can grep.
casey (QA): i'll add a minimal perf script in examples/optkit/perf that toggles prefetch and prints median latency; tag me on the examples PR and i'll run it on my workstation + a small dedicated canary.
tess (Docs): plan: open docs PR (#5402) that: 1) replaces the moved example link 2) inserts the micro-guidance paragraph with explicit numbers 3) adds py+go snippets and the debug grep tip 4) replaces vague quant wording with the recommended phrasing and eval link. and open examples PR (#5403) with the perf script.
harry (Infra): mention that runtime will skip prefetch for very short prefixes (<8 tokens) to avoid extra overhead, and call out memory tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Hosted.
mina (ML): wording suggestion: use explicit recommendation text: "If prefix caching is critical, prefer 8-bit or mixed precision profiles; validate any 4-bit profile against the provided eval set." add a one-line rationale about cache fidelity.
tess (Docs): noted. linkbot: reminder: link-check will run when PR is opened.
linkbot: queued: docs/lint, link-checker.
casey (QA): once both PRs are up i will run perf and paste numbers into the docs changelog and examples README. also happy to run a tiny stress test on Dedicated.
jo (DevEx): i can run a quick snippet-style pass after merge.
tess (Docs): thanks all  checklist in PR description: fix moved link, add micro-guidance, add py+go snippets, include debug grep line, add quant recommendation & eval link, create perf script + tag QA, request reviews from harry/mina/jo/casey. i'll open in ~45m. :sparkles:
